[[File:DoloviteMask.jpg|200px|thumb|An ancient mask made of dolovite]]
'''Dolovite''' was an ore illegally mined by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]]<ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> as well as on [[Nkllon/Legends|Nkllon]], [[Burnin Konn/Legends|Burnin Konn]], and [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. After an "[[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|industrial accident]]" at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on Mustafar, dolovite was driven up to 760 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per barrel. [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] also managed to steal four month's worth of mined dolovite from [[Nomad City]] after his [[Destruction of Nomad City|attack]].
